item.title: Council adopts Wheatley action plan
item.description: Wheatley’s ongoing revitalization efforts will continue, thanks to the adoption of a five-year strategy. It’s been nearly five years since a gas blast rocked the small community’s downtown core, with Chatham-Kent councillors receiving an update Monday. Kyra Knapp, economic development officer, gave the presentation, which outlined achievements to date, goals and next steps. She said […]

item.title: Ursuline Lancers top CKSS Golden Hawks in overtime for LKSSAA hockey title
item.description: The Chatham-Kent Golden Hawks and Ursuline Lancers always deliver a classic in the LKSSAA girls hockey AAA final, and this year was no exception.

item.title: Ursuline Lancers set to challenge for OFSAA volleyball berth
item.description: The Ursuline Lancers have a second chance to punch their ticket to the OFSAA girls volleyball AAA championship.

item.title: Local roundup: Ballhawks win medals; Patriotes swimmers to OFSAA; Kings swept
item.description: Three Chatham Ballhawks teams won medals at Ontario Volleyball Association tournaments last weekend.

item.title: Senior charged in Chatham apartment fire released on bail
item.description: A Chatham senior accused of arson after a fire at a Chatham housing complex has been released on bail. item.title: Suzuki and Cullis to present theatrical performance of their life, activism
item.description: Two internationally acclaimed Canadian environmentalists will bring a theatrical performance of their life and activism to the Chatham Capitol Theatre on Tuesday. item.title: World’s largest dining table fundraiser planned for Noelle's Gift
item.description: Organizers hope to gather people in Chatham around the world’s largest dining table for a local charity on April 11. Titled History Will Be Made, the event, held in support of Noelle’s Gift to Children, will be a celebration of agriculture, sustainability, community spirit and generosity, with 314 guests at the table inside The Armouries.
